description: 地域避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 目黒区. 地震、水害、土砂災害等における目黒区内の避難所の一覧. Coverage: 目黒区. The portal files it under the publisher 目黒区. Its tags are がけ崩れ, 位置情報, 内水氾濫, 土砂災害, 地震. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
